policy: Explicit affected checks only. Unknown impact fails with paths for review; never falls back to full. This is not automatic proof of exhaustive impact.
finalManualGate: Explicit confirmation plus E09-E19 complete and validationPolicy.featureImplementationComplete exactly true. The feature flag is set by root after the E20 feature inventory. E20/E21 acceptance may remain in_progress to avoid a completion cycle.
releaseSourceScope: E11 metadata/license changes only. The source-only checker freezes all 35 runtime module ASTs except the __init__ version literal. Future algorithm changes or new modules must receive a new affected-check plan; they cannot pass as package-only changes.
usage: python scripts/iteration/ci_selected.py --manifest docs/iterations/E11-ci-checks.json --out test-runs/ci-selected (GitHub event base); local: --base COMMIT or --paths-file JSON_ARRAY

savedEvidence.meaning: Exact current-byte rechecks for the existing E01-E10 batch; does not execute or authenticate historical tests. A changed byte requires an explicit rule.
